**Version Info**
State the YTWin-RP version, the browser (name and version) and whether you use the optional browser extension.
Was the video playing on youtube.com or music.youtube.com?

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. If a video was identified wrongly or classified as music/video wrongly, include the video URL.

Have the symptoms of this bug already been reported in another issue? 

**Log Files**
Attach application log files here (found in `%localappdata%\YTWin-RichPresence`). If there are no log files, open Event Viewer and look for any relevant errors under Windows Logs > Application.
